title: Lazar sees Aurora take off at Area 51

tellings.quote: It was a large craft, and it had two huge square exhaust veins, and it sounds more like a rocket than a jet.

plain: In 1989, at Area 51, a secret Air Force test site in the Nevada desert, a man named Bob Lazar, who says he worked on alien craft nearby, says he watched a secret aircraft he calls Aurora take off. He tells Michels it was a large craft with "two huge square exhaust veins" and that it sounded "more like a rocket than a jet." If true, it would be a glimpse of an advanced aircraft the government has never shown.
